Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: An AI prompt template with details, variables, and categories.

userId.description: The firebase auth uid of the creator

description.description: A brief description of what the prompt does

promptText.description: The exact body of the prompt, potentially containing variable placeholders like {{topic}}

category.description: Category like YouTube, Marketing, Coding, Writing, or General

isFavorite.description: Whether the prompt is marked as favorite

notas.description: Optional notes or reminders for executing the specific prompt

isShared.description: Whether the prompt is public and viewable via a shared link without login

authorName.description: The display name of the prompt creator

authorAvatar.description: The URL of the prompt creator's avatar

likedBy.description: List of user UIDs who have liked this prompt

forkedFrom.description: Title of the original prompt this was cloned from

folderId.description: The unique ID of the custom folder setting

PromptVersion.title: PromptVersion
PromptVersion.description: A saved historical state of a prompt's text body.

promptText.description: The previous body text of the prompt.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when this historical state was captured.

PromptComment.title: PromptComment
PromptComment.description: A comment posted by a user on a community prompt.

userId.description: The firebase auth uid of the commenter.

userName.description: The display name of the commenter.

userAvatar.description: The avatar URL of the commenter.

text.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when this comment was posted.

Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: A custom user folder to group prompts.

isShared.description: Whether this folder is shared publicly.

authorName.description: The display name of the folder creator.

/folders/{folderId}.description: User defined folders for custom prompt groupings.

/prompts/{promptId}.description: Collection of save-able AI prompt templates.

/prompts/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}.description: Subcollection storing previous historical states of the promptText for revision reverts.

/prompts/{promptId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Subcollection storing community comments and feedback for a prompt.
